title: Prediction: blindness to self-related stimuli during the self-representational blink

statements.text: The moment of transition into mind wandering is not experienced: a brief loss of self-awareness, the self-representational blink, is followed by an involuntary shift in the unit of identification. The theory predicts that subjects are blind to self-related stimuli, such as interoceptive, vestibular and proprioceptive signals, during that blink.
statements.falsification_criteria: Subjects detect and report self-related stimuli presented during the transition into a mind-wandering episode as well as at other times.

sources.quote: the empirical prediction is that subjects should be blind to self-related stimuli during the SRB
the SRB is characterized by a brief loss of self-awareness, followed by an involuntary shift in the unit of identification
